name: Armed and Adorned
effect: Answers fill up with words about equipping, arming, clothing and decorating ('equipped', 'armed', 'adorned', 'dipped-ladled', 'well-endowed', 'garbed'), plus made-up words like 'Parnut' and odd tokens like '武装'. The answers keep their usual
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
